name: Scoriaceous-Monolith
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
